candidates.seen_facing: Torso faces front-three-quarter toward screen-left (SW), but the head and gaze turn toward screen-right.
candidates.staff_position: Far side, screen-left; the right hand and upright staff sit beside the far shoulder, with much of the shaft visible outside the body contour.
candidates.satchel_position: Near side, screen-right; its broad front panel is exposed in front of the left hip.

reasons.1: Blue wrap tunic, ivory sleeves, brown leather and brass match the master, though the stance is narrower.
reasons.2: Identity and anatomical accessory sides persist; the left-offset chest opening and belt buckle establish SW torso geometry, but the head turns the wrong way.
reasons.3: Hair crown, screen-left sleeve and brass cap highlights support the fixed upper-left key.
reasons.4: Staff, ponytail and satchel remain distinct, but the opposing head turn weakens the directional read at small size.
reasons.5: Controlled painted material planes and restrained cloth and leather texture closely match the master.

candidates.staff_position: Far side, screen-left of the torso; the gripping hand is partly occluded, the shaft disappears behind the tunic, and its lower end shows beside the far boot.
candidates.satchel_position: Near side, broadly exposed on the left hip, screen-right of the staff and beneath the nearer hanging arm.

reasons.1: Garment construction, palette, bracers, boots and satchel hardware closely preserve the master's register.
reasons.2: The near left arm hangs over the exposed left-hip satchel while the right staff arm is behind the torso, preserving handedness.
reasons.3: Upper-left hair, face edge, sleeve and staff-cap highlights remain consistent with a screen-fixed upper-left key.
reasons.4: Left profile and ponytail read clearly; overlap compresses the staff and satchel into the torso at 64 px.
reasons.5: Smooth painted shading with fine, subordinate fabric and leather texture matches the master.

candidates.seen_facing: Back-three-quarter toward screen-left (NW); only an ear and narrow cheek edge are visible, not the front of the face.
candidates.staff_position: Far side, screen-right, beside the far right arm and behind the body's right contour.
candidates.satchel_position: Near side, screen-left, with its broad flap and front panel exposed at the left hip.

reasons.1: Blue divided tunic, ivory shirt, leather fittings and olive satchel retain the master's material and costume vocabulary.
reasons.2: Back-left exposure, near left satchel and far right staff form a coherent rotation of the master without a hand swap.
reasons.3: The screen-left shoulder, sleeve and hair edge carry the strongest key highlights while right-facing planes are subdued.
reasons.4: Back-left turn, projecting satchel, separated boots and upright staff provide a clear small silhouette.
reasons.5: Broad clean shading and restrained surface detail remain consistent with the approved painted treatment.

candidates.seen_facing: Back to the viewer (N), with a slight head turn toward screen-left.
candidates.staff_position: Screen-right in her right hand; in this rear view neither lateral side is substantially nearer.
candidates.satchel_position: Screen-left on her left hip, visible beside the hanging left arm; neither lateral side is substantially nearer.

reasons.1: Rear tunic panels, ponytail, shirt collar, boots and accessory materials are coherent with the master.
reasons.2: Right-hand staff on screen-right and left-hip satchel on screen-left preserve the master's anatomical arrangement from behind.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, shoulder and sleeve highlights establish the upper-left key across the rear-facing pose.
reasons.4: Rear orientation, divided hem, separated feet and laterally separated equipment remain readily legible at small size.
reasons.5: The same controlled painted edges, material separation and modest texture persist across the back surfaces.

candidates.seen_facing: Back-three-quarter toward screen-right (NE); an ear and cheek edge show without the front of the face.
candidates.staff_position: Near side, screen-right; the right forearm and gripping hand project clearly in front of the right torso edge.
candidates.satchel_position: Far side, screen-left; only a narrow portion remains visible behind the body and hanging left arm.

reasons.1: The rear garment, brown bracers and boots, olive satchel and brass fittings preserve the master's design.
reasons.2: Near right staff arm and far left satchel correctly accompany the visible back-right side.
reasons.3: Hair and screen-left shoulder favor the upper-left key, although the bright near right sleeve makes the light direction less decisive.
reasons.4: The near bent staff arm and mostly hidden satchel clearly distinguish this back-right silhouette.
reasons.5: Clean painted folds and restrained material texture closely track the master's brush register.

candidates.staff_position: Near side, screen-right in front of the torso; the visible right forearm crosses toward the upright staff.
candidates.satchel_position: Far left hip, hidden behind the torso; no separate satchel silhouette is visible.

reasons.1: Profile costume, ponytail, bracer lacing, boot construction and palette closely match the master.
reasons.2: The nearer right arm grips the staff and the left satchel is occluded, preserving anatomical handedness in right profile.
reasons.3: Upper-left highlights on the rear hair edge, shoulder, sleeve and staff cap remain fixed despite the right-facing profile.
reasons.4: Face direction, ponytail, bent arm and exposed upright staff form a strong readable profile silhouette.
reasons.5: Painted cloth, hair and leather use the same controlled edge and texture treatment as the master.

candidates.seen_facing: Front-three-quarter toward screen-right (SE), with face and torso turning together.
candidates.staff_position: Near side, screen-left; the right gripping hand and staff project in front of the near arm and tunic edge.
candidates.satchel_position: Far side, screen-right; its narrow angled body is partly hidden by the torso and left arm.

reasons.1: The blue wrap tunic, ivory shirt, leather equipment and olive satchel remain faithful to the master.
reasons.2: The near right staff arm and far left satchel agree with the rightward front-three-quarter facing.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, sleeve, gripping hand and staff-cap highlights maintain the upper-left key.
reasons.4: Coherent rightward face and torso, foreground staff and separated boots give a clear small directional read.
reasons.5: Clean material planes and restrained cloth and leather texture closely match the approved brush register.

candidates.staff_position: Near side, screen-left in front of the torso; the camera-facing arm grips the staff, occupying the anatomical left-arm position for this facing.
candidates.satchel_position: Hidden on the far side behind the torso, instead of exposed on the near left hip required by the master.

reasons.1: Costume palette, materials, ponytail and hardware remain visually close to the master.
reasons.2: Mirrored: left-facing geometry puts the visible staff-holding arm on the near left side and hides the satchel that should occupy the near left hip.
reasons.3: Hair, screen-right sleeve and right-edge staff-cap highlights indicate an upper-right key rather than the required upper-left key.
reasons.4: The left profile, ponytail and exposed staff remain clear at small size despite the anatomical reversal.
reasons.5: The painted material planes, edge handling and restrained surface texture remain consistent with the master.
